text:
maya: Quick thread to decide pilot gating: Sales wants 'live demo' for auditors (interactive queries) + BYOK for one pilot tenant. Can we do a safe hybrid for pilot only?

owen: Hybrid seems possible if we isolate the audit runtime. Option: spin a dedicated single-tenant search instance that accepts a short-lived unwrap token provided by the customer and audited in realtime.

sol: Security concerns: single-tenant instance must run in isolated VPC, HSM-backed unwrapping, and strict ephemeral key handling. No plaintext persisted beyond export window. :no_entry_sign:

rachel: Legal needs: written consent from customer for temporary unwrap, a recorded attestation, and explicit clause that Redwood won't store the unwrap token. Also require indemnity if keys leaked during the window.

maya: Operational constraints: we can provision an isolated runtime in ~5 days, but need a playbook: who requests, who approves, what logs are captured, how to prove key usage.

owen: Tech checklist for the pilot runtime:
- dedicated VM + network isolation
- HSM unwrap + ephemeral memory zeroization test
- audit trail: who used key, when, command args, and signed attestation
- auto-destroy of runtime and zero retention of unwrap token

sol: Add security tests: fuzz unwrapping path, simulate node crash during unwrap, and verify no core dump contains keys. Require pentest before pilot starts.

rachel: On contracts: I'll draft a one-page 'temporary unwrap consent' that includes timebox, permitted auditors, logging, and inability-to-recover clause if customer refuses escrow. Share by EOD Thurs.

maya: Acceptance criteria for pilot unlock:
- isolated runtime deployed and smoke-tested in staging
- HSM unwrap validated + memory zeroization test passed
- legal consent doc signed by customer + ops checklist executed
- run produces signed export artifacts (manifest + signer cert) and attestation log

legal-bot: Created task PKG-4321 "pilot-byok-ephemeral-unwrap-playbook" assigned to @owen,@rachel due 6112400000. Link: https://rwd/tasks/PKG-4321

own: I'll size infra and post cost estimate in the ticket. If pilot customer needs frequent interactive audits we should bill for dedicated runtime hours.

maya: OK — run with this plan. Owen, Sol, Rachel: sync tomorrow to finalize checklist. I'll notify Sales to get customer sign-off on the consent doc. :thumbsup:
